_doc: named SotES (EN-old) state for rd. Pointer chains from src/world_layout.h; validated on runs (see each note). Add only validated names; a run's own names live in <run>/vars.json.

world.note: the world singleton (0 until the first room exists: title / new-game / prologue)

room.note: packed room id (210110 town arrival, 210120 house front, 210140 house interior, 210141 bedroom — kirby transfer NOTES)

lx.note: leader x, px*100 (+240/frame walking; left wall 6400 in 210140)

ly.note: leader y, px*100 (floors in 210140: 52000 / 36000 stairs top / 32800 / 16800)

script.note: 1 = a script owns the game (cutscene / conversation), 0 = free roam (>60 dumps, 4 rooms)

dlg.note: the open dialogue box object, 0 = none

control.note: the player has control (free roam, no box)

tctrl.note: the title menu controller: the title scene's this (on the caller's stack at 0x58fffcf8) → pool → node array [0] → +0x48 child array [0]. Validated on two title visits (probe title-options-bonus, 2026-11-13)

tcur.note: title cursor: 0 Start, 1 Continue, 2 Bonus Menu, 3 Options, 4 Exit; -1 while a sub-screen owns the menu (follows a press 1 frame later)

tcount.note: title menu rows: 5 while the title menu is live (the 'title is up' test)

gold.note: money in CP (room +0x4014): = the F1 panel (893), inn fee 893→887, game-over loss 887→799 (rd probe story-barness-hills)

hp.note: leader HP (slot +0xa64): = F1 panel 172/172, drops with damage, inn refill (story-barness-hills); +0xa68 = base max HP (shown max adds equipment)

party.note: bit i = party slot i active (slot +0x9c4 == 1; room +0x4030 + 4i). Day 6 Barness: 1 (Arche alone); Sana's slot reads 2 there (away/sick?) (story-barness-hills)

lpose.note: leader's current move id (rd probes combat-moves + combat-party, pictures): Slash 10101 (also in the air), Thrust 10102, Downstab 10103, Arcing Slash 10104 (↑+X), Snap Thrust 10105, Roll/Cartwheel 10108, Wide Slash 10109, Jumpkick 10110 (→ ↑ X), Combo Slash 10111; Diamond Dust 20101, Heal Water 20102; 117 asleep / guarding, 98 / 99 hit. Move table at char +0x754 (0x300 per record)

foe.note: 1 while an enemy is near (turned 1 with the off-screen enemy marker; combat-moves)

lid.note: leader character id: 50010 Arche, 50011 Sana (Enter switches; combat-party)

lstate.note: leader body state: 0 stand / attack, 1 walk / dash, 2 crouch / slide, 3 rising (incl. ~4 take-off frames), 4 falling, 5 guard / look up (combat-party, field-movement)

cam.note: camera mode (room +0x4058): F6 cycles 0 plain → 1 LOCK → 2 LONG (HUD icon; field-movement)

zunder.note: event zone id under the leader, 0 = none (story-barness-caves; matched the zone-actor scan)

zrest.note: zone hold timer: reset to 30 while a hostile is near, the zone can fire at 0 (story-barness-caves; zone_pass 0x59a1f0)

diff.note: difficulty (10 = Easy on the Day 6 save; story-barness-caves)

defeats.note: party defeats / game overs (7 on the Day 6 run; story-barness-caves)

retry.note: game over 'Return To Safety' room (270120 on Day 6; story-barness-caves)

atk.note: leader attack shown = base slot+0xa74 + bonus +0xa9c (Power Drop +2 → only +0xa9c changed; Status page matched; items-use)

mpmax.note: base max MP +0xa70 + bonus +0xab0 (Mystery Juice +4; items-use). HP: base max +0xa68, bonus +0xaac

clevel.note: combat level (max at +0xadc); adventurer level +0xae0, EXP +0xae8, to next +0xaec (items-use, Status page)
